title: GETPIVOTDATA resolves visible PivotTable cells without trimming, matches "(blank)" for blank items, and returns #N/A for a reference data_field
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, GETPIVOTDATA(data_field, pivot_table, [field1, item1, ...]) returns #REF! for an odd argument count, a non-PivotTable reference, a hidden/filtered item, or an omitted inner field lacking a visible subtotal; returns #N/A when data_field is a cell reference (while numeric/logical/empty data_field gives #REF!) or when an error appears in data_field, pivot_table, or a field name (whereas an error in an item argument gives #REF!); matches data_field case-insensitively against caption or base field name without trimming trailing spaces; and matches blank pivot items via the text "(blank)" rather than "". Matches 1,400/1,400 scalar probe rows (#REF!) and the pivot_getpivotdata oracle workbook.
basis: Measured across Excel 16.0.20527.20150 in crates/calc-host/tests/captures/pivot_getpivotdata/oracle.capture.json (123 formulas), Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in prefix_metadata row 286, and 1,400/1,400 scalar probe rows in CalcFunc-Evidence single-cell-answers-getpivotdata-scalar.json.
